dashboard.name: Fitbit & N-of-1 Health
dashboard.description: Private Fitbit trends, sleep, nutrition, check-ins, and experiment adherence. Data remains in the Homelab Health database.

cards.name: Health · Daily steps
cards.description: Daily total steps from Fitbit or Google Health.
cards.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts, metric_type, source) ts, metric_type, source,
         CASE WHEN unit = 'm' THEN value / 1000.0 ELSE value END AS value
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('steps') AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
), per_source AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, metric_type, source, SUM(value) AS total
  FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), t AS (
  SELECT day, metric_type, MAX(total) AS total FROM per_source GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT day, total::bigint AS steps FROM t ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Daily active calories
cards.description: Daily active energy burned (not food calories).
cards.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts, metric_type, source) ts, metric_type, source,
         CASE WHEN unit = 'm' THEN value / 1000.0 ELSE value END AS value
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('calories') AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
), per_source AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, metric_type, source, SUM(value) AS total
  FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), t AS (
  SELECT day, metric_type, MAX(total) AS total FROM per_source GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT day, ROUND(total) AS active_kcal FROM t ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Daily distance
cards.description: Distance normalized to kilometres across Fitbit and Google Health sources.
cards.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts, metric_type, source) ts, metric_type, source,
         CASE WHEN unit = 'm' THEN value / 1000.0 ELSE value END AS value
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('distance') AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
), per_source AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, metric_type, source, SUM(value) AS total
  FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), t AS (
  SELECT day, metric_type, MAX(total) AS total FROM per_source GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT day, ROUND(total::numeric, 2) AS km FROM t ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Daily heart rate
cards.description: Daily mean, low, and high heart rate.
cards.sql:
SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, ROUND(AVG(value)) AS avg_bpm, MIN(value)::int AS min_bpm, MAX(value)::int AS max_bpm
FROM metric_samples
WHERE metric_type = 'heart_rate' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Intraday heart-rate profile
cards.description: Average heart rate by local hour over the last 30 days.
cards.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::int AS local_hour, ROUND(AVG(value)) AS avg_bpm
FROM metric_samples
WHERE metric_type = 'heart_rate' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Resting heart rate
cards.description: Available when the Fitbit export includes resting-heart-rate records.
cards.sql:
SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, ROUND(AVG(value)) AS resting_bpm
FROM metric_samples
WHERE metric_type = 'resting_heart_rate' AND ts >= now() - interval '180 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Sleep duration and efficiency
cards.sql:
SELECT date_of_sleep AS day, ROUND(minutes_asleep / 60.0, 2) AS hours_asleep, COALESCE(efficiency, ROUND(100.0 * minutes_asleep * 60 / NULLIF(duration_seconds, 0))::int) AS efficiency
FROM sleep_sessions
WHERE is_main_sleep AND date_of_sleep >= current_date - 90
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Sleep stages
cards.description: Minutes in each Fitbit sleep stage by sleep date.
cards.sql:
SELECT ss.date_of_sleep AS day, st.level AS stage, ROUND(SUM(st.seconds) / 60.0, 1) AS minutes
FROM sleep_stages st
JOIN sleep_sessions ss ON ss.source = st.source AND ss.log_id = st.log_id
WHERE ss.is_main_sleep AND ss.date_of_sleep >= current_date - 90
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

cards.name: Health · SpO2 and breathing rate
cards.description: Optional Fitbit export metrics; blank until imported.
cards.sql:
SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, metric_type, ROUND(AVG(value)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM metric_samples
WHERE metric_type IN ('spo2', 'breathing_rate') AND ts >= now() - interval '180 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

cards.name: N-of-1 · Check-in and weight
cards.description: Self-reported daily ratings and weight from the N-of-1 logger.
cards.sql:
SELECT checkin_date AS day, weight_kg, energy, mood, stress, sleep_quality
FROM daily_checkins
WHERE checkin_date >= current_date - 180
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: N-of-1 · Daily nutrition
cards.description: Only confirmed food records contribute to calories and macros.
cards.sql:
SELECT day, calories, protein_g, carbohydrates_g, fat_g
FROM n1_daily_nutrition
WHERE day >= current_date - 90
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: N-of-1 · Intervention adherence
cards.description: Completed, skipped, and missed logged intervention events by experiment.
cards.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(experiment_name, 'Unlinked') AS experiment, adherence, COUNT(*) AS events
FROM n1_experiment_adherence
WHERE day >= current_date - 180
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

cards.name: N-of-1 · Context periods
cards.description: Illness, travel, alcohol, injury, medication, stress, and other tagged time ranges that may confound an experiment.
cards.sql:
SELECT category, label, starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS started_local, ends_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS ended_local, notes
FROM context_events
WHERE starts_at >= now() - interval '180 days' OR ends_at IS NULL
ORDER BY starts_at DESC

cards.name: Health · Heart rate variability
cards.description: Daily HRV (RMSSD, ms) from Google Health. Higher than your usual usually means better recovery.
cards.sql:
SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, ROUND(AVG(value)::numeric, 1) AS hrv_ms
FROM metric_samples
WHERE metric_type = 'hrv' AND ts >= now() - interval '180 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Weekly averages
cards.description: Week-by-week averages of daily steps, active calories, resting heart rate, HRV, and sleep so slow trends stand out.
cards.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts, metric_type, source) ts, metric_type, source,
         CASE WHEN unit = 'm' THEN value / 1000.0 ELSE value END AS value
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('steps', 'calories') AND ts >= now() - interval '180 days'
), per_source AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, metric_type, source, SUM(value) AS total
  FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), t AS (
  SELECT day, metric_type, MAX(total) AS total FROM per_source GROUP BY 1, 2
), v AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day,
         AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'resting_heart_rate') AS resting_bpm,
         AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'hrv') AS hrv_ms
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('resting_heart_rate', 'hrv') AND ts >= now() - interval '180 days'
  GROUP BY 1
), s AS (
  SELECT date_of_sleep AS day, SUM(minutes_asleep) / 60.0 AS hours_asleep
  FROM sleep_sessions
  WHERE is_main_sleep AND date_of_sleep >= current_date - 180
  GROUP BY 1
), d AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(a.day, v.day, s.day) AS day,
         MAX(a.total) FILTER (WHERE a.metric_type = 'steps') AS steps,
         MAX(a.total) FILTER (WHERE a.metric_type = 'calories') AS active_kcal,
         MAX(v.resting_bpm) AS resting_bpm, MAX(v.hrv_ms) AS hrv_ms, MAX(s.hours_asleep) AS hours_asleep
  FROM t a
  FULL JOIN v ON v.day = a.day
  FULL JOIN s ON s.day = COALESCE(a.day, v.day)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT date_trunc('week', day)::date AS week,
       ROUND(AVG(steps)) AS avg_steps,
       ROUND(AVG(active_kcal)) AS avg_active_kcal,
       ROUND(AVG(resting_bpm)::numeric, 1) AS avg_resting_bpm,
       ROUND(AVG(hrv_ms)::numeric, 1) AS avg_hrv_ms,
       ROUND(AVG(hours_asleep)::numeric, 2) AS avg_hours_asleep
FROM d
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Health · Daily summary
cards.description: One row per day for the last 30 days: activity, heart, sleep, vitals, and any context tags.
cards.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ts, metric_type, source) ts, metric_type, source,
         CASE WHEN unit = 'm' THEN value / 1000.0 ELSE value END AS value
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('steps', 'calories', 'distance') AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
), per_source AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, metric_type, source, SUM(value) AS total
  FROM r GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
), t AS (
  SELECT day, metric_type, MAX(total) AS total FROM per_source GROUP BY 1, 2
), v AS (
  SELECT (ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day,
         ROUND(AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'heart_rate')) AS avg_bpm,
         ROUND(AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'resting_heart_rate')) AS resting_bpm,
         ROUND((AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'hrv'))::numeric, 1) AS hrv_ms,
         ROUND((AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'spo2'))::numeric, 1) AS spo2,
         ROUND((AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'breathing_rate'))::numeric, 1) AS breaths_per_min
  FROM metric_samples
  WHERE metric_type IN ('heart_rate', 'resting_heart_rate', 'hrv', 'spo2', 'breathing_rate') AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1
), a AS (
  SELECT day,
         MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'steps')::bigint AS steps,
         ROUND(MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'calories')) AS active_kcal,
         ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE metric_type = 'distance'))::numeric, 2) AS km
  FROM t GROUP BY 1
), s AS (
  SELECT date_of_sleep AS day, ROUND(SUM(minutes_asleep) / 60.0, 1) AS hours_asleep, MAX(COALESCE(efficiency, ROUND(100.0 * minutes_asleep * 60 / NULLIF(duration_seconds, 0))::int)) AS sleep_efficiency
  FROM sleep_sessions
  WHERE is_main_sleep AND date_of_sleep >= current_date - 30
  GROUP BY 1
), c AS (
  SELECT day, string_agg(contexts, '; ') AS tags
  FROM n1_context_days
  WHERE day >= current_date - 30
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.day, v.day, s.day) AS day, a.steps, a.active_kcal, a.km, v.avg_bpm, v.resting_bpm, v.hrv_ms,
       s.hours_asleep, s.sleep_efficiency, v.spo2, v.breaths_per_min, c.tags
FROM a
FULL JOIN v ON v.day = a.day
FULL JOIN s ON s.day = COALESCE(a.day, v.day)
LEFT JOIN c ON c.day = COALESCE(a.day, v.day, s.day)
ORDER BY 1 DESC
